## Install

1. Download **NotchBar-x.y.z.dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **NotchBar** onto **Applications**.
3. Open NotchBar from Applications. A setup window walks you through connecting Claude Code, Open at login and Terminal tab jumping.

Requires macOS 13 or later. Runs on Apple Silicon and Intel.

If macOS says it can't verify NotchBar, open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, click **Open Anyway** next to NotchBar, and confirm. See the README for details.
